item.title: UK government publishes bill to end new North Sea drilling licences
item.body: Labour ministers have published legislation that would end the granting of new oil and gas licences. The bill has been published but is not yet law.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | ⚡ UK government publishes bill to end new North Sea drilling licences

Labour ministers have published legislation that would end the granting of new oil and gas licences. The bill has been published but is not yet law.

Source: BBC | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 4 November, 17:50
